verifications.note:
Verified on candidate sha256:9f3ca298 (source ea9051b2, FE10 8cb3bb8), in EN (LTR) and AR (RTL), in a disposable stack with synthetic data.
- My round-13 reproductions now pass unchanged. r13-session-end-ui: in-app link and reload, 4/4, with raised and default limits; each in-app link makes 1 /me where round 13 made about 130 per second. r13-ui (c): after the 401 upload refusal the user is on /login with the localized message, with no EN leak and 0 revisions. r13-ui-withdrawn: the message on /login at about 270 ms, and signing in again returns to the evidence page.
- New r14-session-end-ui, 31/31 with raised limits and 31/31 with the product's default limits. It covers a real second tab clicking Sign out, an administrator revocation, idle expiry, absolute expiry and logout by API. Every trigger lands exactly once on /login?returnTo=/transformations&error=session_expired, with the form and the localized message and the correct dir. Each makes /me = 1 in 10 s, with 0 429s and no stale shell. A second context from the same IP signs in, and signing in again returns to /transformations.
- Source: the session phase lives in the API client (unknown/active/ended). A 401 'unauthenticated' while active ends the session once, and a 403 never does. RequireSession disables /me, clears the cache once and navigates once. LoginPage trusts only a /me answered after it mounted.
- Limit noted, not a defect: a tab learns that its session ended only from its next server request. A navigation served entirely from cache shows the page until then.
